summary: Iteration 63 - All new features tested and verified. Theme Gallery UI button opens modal with Browse/My Presets/Create tabs. Theme Preview Mode shows split-screen dark/light comparison with 6 accent colors. Fixed critical bug: double /api/api/ URL prefix in ThemePresetGallery.js and SearchResultComments.js. Backend: 14/14 tests passed. Frontend: All features working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Theme Gallery UI - Opens from sidebar button, shows Browse/My Presets/Create tabs, displays preset cards with name, author, likes, accent color
Theme Preview Mode - Split-screen comparison of dark vs light mode with 6 accent color options, Apply buttons on both sides
Accent Color Picker - 6 colors working: Royal Purple, Hot Pink, Ocean Blue, Forest Green, Sunset Orange, Ruby Red
Search Result Comments - API endpoints exist and working, UI component ready for integration
seed_data_creation: Created test theme presets during API testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 63 verified: 1) Theme Gallery button in sidebar opens ThemePresetGallery modal with Browse/My Presets/Create tabs. Presets display with name, author, likes, accent color. 2) Theme Preview button opens ThemePreviewMode modal with split-screen dark/light comparison. Each side has mode toggle and 6 color options. 3) Fixed critical bug: double /api/api/ URL prefix in ThemePresetGallery.js and SearchResultComments.js. 4) All 6 accent colors working: purple, pink, blue, green, orange, red. 5) SearchResultComments component ready but not yet integrated into main UI (no search results to test comments on).

Theme_Gallery_Button.details: Button with data-testid='open-theme-gallery' in sidebar. Opens ThemePresetGallery modal with z-index 10000.

Theme_Gallery_Modal.details: Modal shows Browse/My Presets/Create tabs. Browse shows public presets. Create form has name input and save button.

Theme_Preview_Button.details: Button with data-testid='open-theme-preview' in sidebar. Opens ThemePreviewMode modal.

Theme_Preview_Modal.details: Split-screen comparison with left (dark) and right (light) panels. Each has mode toggle and 6 color options. Apply buttons on both sides.

Accent_Color_Picker.details: 6 colors: purple, pink, blue, green, orange, red. All have data-testid='accent-color-{color}'. Color picker dropdown works.

Theme_Preset_API.details: GET /api/theme-presets, POST /api/theme-presets, POST /api/theme-presets/{id}/like, DELETE /api/theme-presets/{id} - all working.

Search_Result_Comments_API.details: GET/POST/DELETE /api/search-results/{id}/comments endpoints exist and respond correctly.
